name: Binaced (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, red above with a white Maltese cross and white below with a green eradicated tree.
history: The flag is represented on a cloth whose length is three halves of its width, parted diagonally from the upper fly corner to the lower hoist corner: the upper part red with a white eight-pointed cross, and the lower part white with a green eradicated tree.
